result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers leave the desktop rule alone and add a max-width: 600px media query with clamp(32px, ~10vw, 44px). That gives about 37-39px at 390px, keeps tight leading and negative tracking, leaves .lead untouched, and should wrap to about 3 lines with no overflow. A adds overflow-wrap as a safeguard, and B explains more clearly why the headline was breaking. Neither difference is enough to pick one over the other. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers use the same approach: a 600px media query with a clamp() around 9.5–10vw capped at 44px. That gives about 37–39px at 390px, which should wrap to about 3 lines, keeps tight leading and negative tracking, and leaves desktop and .lead unchanged. B adds overflow-wrap as an extra guard and a tablet tip, while A explains the cause more clearly; neither difference changes the result.
